name: Clapping Hands In Church
overview: Scripture portrays clapping hands as an expression of joyful praise and celebration before God, as seen in Psalms 47:1 where all people are called to clap and shout with triumph. This imagery extends to creation itself, with the floods, hills, mountains, and trees depicted as clapping or singing in joyful response to God's goodness (Psalms 98:8; Isaiah 55:12). Though Revelation 1:1 does not address clapping directly, it emphasizes the revelation from Christ to His servants, reminding believers that such acts of worship are rooted in the divine truth revealed to His church.
